extracts.title: Richmond Election October 17
factsUsed: The City of Richmond notice is dated July 28, 2026.
The 2026 General Local and School Election is scheduled for Saturday, October 17, 2026.
The election will choose one Mayor, eight Councillors and seven School Board Trustees.
Eligible Richmond residents are encouraged to register through Elections BC until Tuesday, August 18.
The city points residents to an Am I on the Voters List search tool.
Advance voting is listed for October 3, 7, 8, 9 and 10.
Accessible options listed by the city include curb-side voting, mail ballots and an accessible ballot-marking device at City Hall during advance voting.

extracts.title: Local Government Elections
factsUsed: The elections page is the City of Richmond hub for where, when and how to vote.
The July 28 notice directs residents to the elections page for further election information.
